title: EA Championships 2018
text:
Congratulations to our seven age-class winners - Theo, Barney, Chloe, Matthew, Bronwen, Lizzie and Sally - at the 2018 EA Championships on 25th March. This year's event was hosted by SOS in Writtle Forest. The event results are given on the SOS and EAOA websites, while our SuffOC winners are summarised here.

Matthew Clark was also awarded the Joan George Trophy for the best performance by a Junior.
